subject: Process ownership — Shipping CS Monday board
body:
Hi all,

Who currently owns the Monday board for shipping CS? I need to update some access permissions and want to make sure I route the request to the right person.

If there's a process-ownership doc somewhere I missed, point me at it.

Thanks,
Ops Director

expected_outcome.notes: Internal process-ownership question ('who owns the Shipping CS Monday board'). The live Org Chart / Unified Routing SOP supports an answer, so the chain drafts an internal reply pending Ops Manager approval (Ops Manager owns process governance). Role is deterministic; the current role holder (person) is resolved from the Org Chart at runtime, never hardcoded.
